facility_roles.quote: The higher energy and intensity evolution of AdA, ADONE, started the study of the electron-positron collisions physics in Frascati.

intervals.label: ADONE two-beam data taking for FENICE
intervals.note: Year precision for the start. The same page says elsewhere that 'in 1991, electron-positron operation was resumed to study neutron-antineutron production ... (FENICE experiment)'; 1990 is taken from the sentence that dates the two-beam resumption and the FENICE data taking. The end is the ADONE shutdown on 26 April 1993.
intervals.quote: In 1990, after several years dedicated to single beam operation for synchrotron radiation and nuclear physics, two beam operation with electrons and positrons was resumed to perform the last subnuclear physics experiment, FENICE, whose data taking lasted until the final shutdown of ADONE in 1993.

intervals.label: data taking ended
intervals.note: FENICE data taking 'lasted until the final shutdown of ADONE in 1993'.
intervals.quote: ADONE was shut down on April 26, 1993 to allow the construction of a new low energy, high luminosity collider, DAFNE, inside its building

name: FENICE
notes: The INFN-LNF page calls FENICE 'the last subnuclear physics experiment' at ADONE.
No publication abstract was fetchable (Elsevier pages return 403), so no result record was written.

physics_goals.quote: The FENICE experiment's goal is to overcome a gap in our knowledge about the internal structure of the neutron, by measuring its electromagnetic form factor through the reaction electron + positron -> neutron + antineutron.
physics_goals.value: Neutron electromagnetic form factor in the timelike region from e+e- → neutron-antineutron

summary.plain: The last particle-physics experiment at Frascati's ADONE collider (1990 to 1993). It measured the neutron's electromagnetic form factor from electron-positron annihilation into neutron-antineutron pairs, a measurement never made before.
summary.technical: FENICE at ADONE: two-beam e⁺e⁻ operation resumed in 1990 for e⁺e⁻ → n n̄ and the neutron electromagnetic form factor, to complement the proton-antiproton data; data taking until the shutdown on 26 April 1993.
